title: Main Stage Production: Seussical - The Musical
en: Dr. Seuss favorites Horton and the Cat in the Hat lead a playful musical journey through the Jungle of Nool, Circus McGurkus and the world of the Whos.
zh: 苏斯博士的经典角色霍顿和戴帽子的猫登上舞台，带领全家走进努尔丛林、马戏团和 Whos 的奇妙世界。

title: PAUSD Outreach Production: Escondido Elementary (Noble Gnarble)
en: A tiny sea creature dreams of seeing the sky. Follow its brave underwater journey past doubts and dangers in Escondido Elementary's production of Journey of the Noble Gnarble.
zh: Escondido Elementary 上演儿童音乐剧《Journey of the Noble Gnarble》。小海洋生物勇闯深海，克服质疑和危险，努力实现看见天空的梦想。
